```{r cars, fig.width=7, fig.height=7, dpi=200, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# 0) Packages
# ===============================
packages <- c("readxl", "dplyr", "tidyr", "circlize", "showtext", "tibble")
need <- packages[!packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if(length(need) > 0) install.packages(need, dependencies = TRUE)

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(circlize)
library(showtext)
library(tibble)

# ===============================
# 1) Font: Arial Bold (fallback)
# ===============================
try({
  font_add("ArialBold", "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf")
  showtext_auto()
  par(family = "ArialBold")
}, silent = TRUE)

if(is.null(par("family")) || par("family") == "") {
  par(family = "Arial", font = 2)
}

# ===============================
# 2) Read your Excel data
# ===============================
file_path <- "/Users/zixuanzhao/Desktop/MKG/JMI/JMI-Old/CPSP/Composition2.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(file_path)

# Auto-detect long (from/to/value) or wide adjacency
col_lower <- tolower(colnames(df))
is_long <- (any(col_lower == "from") && any(col_lower == "to"))

if(is_long) {
  names(df) <- gsub("\\s+", "_", names(df))
  from_col <- names(df)[tolower(names(df)) == "from"][1]
  to_col   <- names(df)[tolower(names(df)) == "to"][1]

  val_candidates <- names(df)[tolower(names(df)) %in% c("value","count","weight","freq","n")]
  if(length(val_candidates) == 0) stop("Long format but no value/count column. Name it value/count/weight.")
  val_col <- val_candidates[1]

  data_long <- df %>%
    transmute(
      from  = as.character(.data[[from_col]]),
      to    = as.character(.data[[to_col]]),
      value = as.numeric(.data[[val_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value), value > 0, from != to)

} else {
  df_wide <- as.data.frame(df)
  row_name_col <- names(df_wide)[1]
  rownames(df_wide) <- df_wide[[row_name_col]]
  df_wide[[row_name_col]] <- NULL
  df_wide[] <- lapply(df_wide, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

  data_long <- df_wide %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "from") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -from, names_to = "to", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(from = as.character(from), to = as.character(to)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value), value > 0, from != to)
}

# ===============================
# 3) Colors (replace if needed)
# ===============================
sectors <- unique(c(data_long$from, data_long$to))
base_cols <- c(
  "#89C4C0", "#7EB6D4", "#E8B97A", "#E4A07A",
  "#B5C9A1", "#B8A9C9", "#7ABCB8", "#A8C8D8",
  "#D4A96A", "#A9C4B8", "#C8B4D0", "#9CB8C4",
  "#B8C8A8", "#8EB0C0", "#C4A8A0"   
)
grid_col <- rep(base_cols, length.out = length(sectors))
names(grid_col) <- sectors

# ===============================
# 4) Circos parameters (fix label clipping)
#    - canvas.xlim/ylim: enlarge drawing canvas
#    - par(xpd=NA): allow drawing outside plot region
#    - mar: add margins
# ===============================
circos.clear()
circos.par(
  start.degree = 90,
  gap.degree = 8,
  track.margin = c(0.002, 0.015),
  cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
  points.overflow.warning = FALSE,
  canvas.xlim = c(-1.50, 1.50),
  canvas.ylim = c(-1.50, 1.50)
)

par(mar = c(6, 6, 6, 6), xpd = NA)

# ===============================
# 5) Chord diagram
#    - annotationTrackHeight: increase outer ring space
# ===============================
chordDiagram(
  x = data_long,
  grid.col = grid_col,
  transparency = 0.15,
  annotationTrack = "grid",
  annotationTrackHeight = c(0.04, 0.11),
  link.sort = TRUE,
  link.largest.ontop = TRUE
)

# ===============================
# 6) Outer segmented ring border
# ===============================
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  bg.border = "grey20",
  bg.lwd = 2,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {}
)

# ===============================
# 7) Labels: radial + selective red color
# ===============================
highlight_labels <- c("Main", "Aux", "Low-MP", "Refractory")

circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  bg.border = NA,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {

    xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
    si   <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")

    # 判断是否是这四个
    label_color <- ifelse(si %in% highlight_labels, "#C00000", "black")

    circos.text(
      x = mean(xlim),
      y = 1.25,
      labels = si,
      facing = "clockwise",
      niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.5),
      cex = 0.60,
      font = 2,
      col = label_color   # 👈 关键就在这里
    )
  }
)
message("Done. If labels still overlap: increase gap.degree, reduce cex, or shorten sector names.")
```
